newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chubu Electric issues power buying tender.
newsitem.headline: Chubu Electric issues power buying tender.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Thursday that it had issued a tender to buy 400,000 kilowatts (kw) of electricity on a wholesale basis for fiscal 2003/04 and 2004/05.
The tender opens on April 11 and closes on August 28, the utility said in a statement.
Winners will conclude contracts with Chubu Electric by the end of February 1998, the statement said.
In the fiscal year which ended on March 31, six of Japan's 10 electricity utilities decided to buy a combined 3.05 million kilowatts (kw) of power through tenders.
Utilities issued their first buying tenders last year following industry deregulation in December 1995, which opened the business to independent power producers.
Seven utilities, including Chubu Electric, have said they plan to issue tenders this year, to buy a combined 2.86 million kw of electricity.
